title: Claude driver extensions
description: Extensions of the `claude` driver: `claude.hooks` (Claude Code's settings hooks, set for a live thread with `Query.applyFlagSettings`, and every hook run reported as an `x:claude.hook` event) and `claude.fileCheckpoints` (Claude Code's file checkpoints, rewound with `Query.rewindFiles`). The driver lists each in `capabilities.extensions` with version `1`; calls go through `session.ext(ns, method, params)`, and each extension event carries a plain-text `fallback`. Thread and turn ids are ARI ids. The driver also fills the shared `ari.goal` extension, derived from the transcript.

ClaudeHookPhase.description: Which hook message Claude Code sent: `started`, `progress` or `response`.

ClaudeHookEventData.description: One hook message (`hook_started`, `hook_progress` or `hook_response`) Claude Code streamed.

hookEvent.description: The hook event, for example `PreToolUse` or `Stop`.

ClaudeHookEvent.description: Event body: Claude Code ran a hook.

matcher.description: Which tools or sources the hooks run for, for example `Bash` or `Edit|Write`.

ClaudeHooksSetParams.description: Params of `claude.hooks` `set`: the hooks by hook event (`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, ...), replacing the ones set before for the thread's live query; `null` removes them. Claude Code's settings files keep their own hooks. Result: `null`.

ClaudeRewindParams.description: Params of `claude.fileCheckpoints` `rewind`: restore the files Claude Code changed to their state when the turn's prompt was sent. `dryRun` reports what would change without changing it.

ClaudeRewindResult.description: Result of `claude.fileCheckpoints` `rewind`, as Claude Code reports it.
